metadata.description: Git utility skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: avar-review
plugins.description: Channel Ævar Arnfjörð Bjarmason to review code for completeness, test coverage, and behavioral regressions

plugins.name: bulk-catchup-rebase
plugins.description: Bulk-rebase a long-lived branch that trails upstream by many commits using iterative merges and rerere

plugins.name: claude-rebase
plugins.description: Interactive rebase via patches — reorder, edit, squash, and reword commits without git rebase -i

plugins.name: git-rebase-i
plugins.description: Scripted git rebase -i — reword, edit, or drop commits without interactive mode

plugins.name: gitster-review
plugins.description: Channel Junio C Hamano to review code for design coherence, series narrative, and long-term maintainability

plugins.name: interactive-staging
plugins.description: Selectively stage changes into discrete commits using git plumbing

plugins.name: harmonize-branches
plugins.description: Analyze branch topology, consolidate divergent branches, and resolve conflicts

plugins.name: peff-commit
plugins.description: Write a commit message in the style of Jeff King (peff) from the Git mailing list

plugins.name: peff-review
plugins.description: Channel Jeff King (peff) to review code for simplicity, edge cases, and correctness — with working code alternatives

plugins.name: resolve-merge-conflicts
plugins.description: Resolve merge conflicts in the working tree during an active merge, rebase, or cherry-pick

plugins.name: sunshine-review
plugins.description: Channel Eric Sunshine to review code with meticulous, line-level precision — catching what others skim past
